title: Good: broadcast Lagged error handled without stream termination
description: kith-events/src/lib.rs documents (and tests) that a slow EventSource subscriber receives RecvError::Lagged and must resync via Type/changes rather than treating the error as fatal. The test_lagged_receiver_skips test confirms the BroadcastStream filter_map pattern yields subsequent messages normally after a Lagged error. A contributor unfamiliar with tokio broadcast semantics might replace the filter_map with an unwrap or a stream-terminating error handler, which would disconnect all EventSource clients on any burst of store writes. The design is correct: events are hints, not the source of truth; the resync path via Type/changes is the correct recovery.
